Unapplied website candidates and absence-only discrepancies are not imported. November 6 afternoon review identifies the Ancient Hilt item name and adds cached-template metadata observations. Direct native reward omissions or unresolved groups are not applied to complete published reward lists. November 7 observations cite build 70862. Recorded category corrections do not rewrite primary classifications or supply UiMap positions; record 1156 remains unconfirmed with unknown complete rewards. November 8 partial reward corrections record the choice group without asserting that unobserved guaranteed groups are empty. Native item stats remain client-owned. November 8 evening additions retain unknown choice groups alongside explicitly recorded guaranteed rewards; recorded Azshara categories come only from exact native rows, without coordinates, restrictions or availability inference.
